journeys.name: Anonymous visitor loads home page and primary navigation
journeys.expectedResult: Home page renders with header, footer, and primary nav; no member-only content or controls are visible.
journeys.evidence: Screenshot + HTTP 200 response capture of home route in the rehearsal environment.
journeys.privacyControl: No account or session data used; purely anonymous request.
journeys.defectRouting: Bounded remediation return per #2781 work unit 6 (defect triage).
journeys.executionPath: Automated: scripted GET against rehearsal base URL; asserts 200 + expected DOM landmarks.

journeys.name: Anonymous visitor uses search
journeys.expectedResult: Search returns relevant public results; no private/member-only records are exposed.
journeys.evidence: Captured request/response pair with redacted query terms (synthetic queries only).
journeys.privacyControl: Only synthetic, non-PII query strings from the rehearsal fixture set are used.
journeys.defectRouting: Bounded remediation return per #2781 work unit 6.
journeys.executionPath: Automated: scripted search-endpoint calls with fixture query set; asserts result-shape contract.

journeys.name: Anonymous visitor hits a not-found / degraded route
journeys.expectedResult: Deterministic fallback/error UI renders; no stack trace, secret, or internal path is exposed.
journeys.evidence: Captured 404/5xx response body confirming no leakage.
journeys.privacyControl: No account data involved.
journeys.defectRouting: Stop-and-escalate if any internal detail leaks (secret/private-data exposure protected stop).
journeys.executionPath: Automated: scripted request to a deliberately invalid route; asserts sanitized error contract.

journeys.name: New member joins and logs in
journeys.expectedResult: Join flow completes with a synthetic identity; session is established; member-only surfaces become visible only after login.
journeys.evidence: Redacted session-state transcript (synthetic account only) plus before/after visibility screenshots.
journeys.privacyControl: Synthetic/redacted test identity only; no real member PII or credentials used.
journeys.cleanup: Synthetic account and session are deleted/expired at rehearsal close.
journeys.defectRouting: Bounded remediation return per #2781 work unit 6.
journeys.executionPath: Automated where the auth surface supports scripted synthetic accounts; otherwise documented manual steps with redacted evidence.

journeys.name: Member logs out / session expires
journeys.expectedResult: Member-only surfaces become inaccessible immediately after logout or expiry; no stale session grants access.
journeys.evidence: Captured request proving a post-logout request to a member route is rejected.
journeys.privacyControl: Synthetic identity only.
journeys.defectRouting: Stop-and-escalate if stale-session access is observed (security-relevant defect).
journeys.executionPath: Automated: scripted logout followed by scripted request to a member-only route; asserts rejection.

journeys.name: Unauthenticated request to a member-only route is rejected
journeys.expectedResult: Member-only routes reject unauthenticated requests deterministically (redirect or 401/403), never partial content.
journeys.evidence: Captured response status/body for each member-only route under test.
journeys.privacyControl: No real member data requested or exposed.
journeys.defectRouting: Stop-and-escalate — this is a protected-stop class defect (private/secret exposure) if it fails.
journeys.executionPath: Automated: scripted unauthenticated requests against the member-only route inventory.

journeys.name: Member views/edits profile and member card
journeys.expectedResult: Profile and card render and save correctly for the synthetic member; no other member's data is visible.
journeys.evidence: Redacted before/after profile-state capture for the synthetic account.
journeys.privacyControl: Synthetic account only; no real member profile data used or displayed.
journeys.cleanup: Synthetic profile edits reverted or account deleted at rehearsal close.
journeys.defectRouting: Bounded remediation return per #2781 work unit 6.
journeys.executionPath: Automated where the profile API supports scripted synthetic updates; otherwise documented manual steps.

journeys.name: Member browses gallery / views photo detail
journeys.expectedResult: Gallery and photo detail pages render approved candidate content correctly with correct attribution.
journeys.evidence: Screenshot capture of gallery list and one photo-detail view.
journeys.privacyControl: Only approved rehearsal-candidate media is used; no private/unpublished media exposed.
journeys.defectRouting: Bounded remediation return per #2781 work unit 6.
journeys.executionPath: Automated: scripted GET of gallery + one detail route; asserts 200 and expected metadata fields present.

journeys.name: Member browses library content
journeys.expectedResult: Library listing and item detail render correctly for approved candidate content.
journeys.evidence: Screenshot + response capture of library list and one item detail.
journeys.privacyControl: Only approved rehearsal-candidate content used.
journeys.defectRouting: Bounded remediation return per #2781 work unit 6.
journeys.executionPath: Automated: scripted GET against library list/detail routes.

journeys.name: Member browses memorabilia collection
journeys.expectedResult: Memorabilia listing and detail render correctly for approved candidate content.
journeys.evidence: Screenshot + response capture.
journeys.privacyControl: Only approved rehearsal-candidate content used.
journeys.defectRouting: Bounded remediation return per #2781 work unit 6.
journeys.executionPath: Automated: scripted GET against memorabilia routes.

journeys.name: Member submits a discussion post / content submission
journeys.expectedResult: Synthetic submission is accepted, stored, and visible only per its intended visibility rules (e.g. moderation queue vs. public).
journeys.evidence: Redacted submission payload and resulting stored-state capture.
journeys.privacyControl: Synthetic content only; clearly marked as rehearsal data so it cannot be mistaken for real member content.
journeys.cleanup: Synthetic submission deleted at rehearsal close.
journeys.defectRouting: Bounded remediation return per #2781 work unit 6.
journeys.executionPath: Automated where the submission API supports scripted synthetic posts; otherwise documented manual steps.

journeys.name: Content/media displays correct source, rights, and attribution
journeys.expectedResult: Every displayed media item in the candidate carries correct attribution/rights metadata; no orphaned or misattributed media is shown.
journeys.evidence: Sampled attribution-field capture across the candidate media set.
journeys.privacyControl: Uses only approved candidate media; no private source material.
journeys.defectRouting: Bounded remediation return per #2781 work unit 6.
journeys.executionPath: Automated: scripted metadata sampling against the media API/content collection.

journeys.name: Content publication and takedown controls behave correctly
journeys.expectedResult: Publishing a synthetic item makes it visible per its scope; taking it down removes it from public surfaces immediately.
journeys.evidence: Before/after visibility capture around a synthetic publish/takedown cycle.
journeys.privacyControl: Synthetic content only.
journeys.cleanup: Synthetic item deleted after the cycle completes.
journeys.defectRouting: Stop-and-escalate if takedown fails to remove content (rights/compliance-relevant defect).
journeys.executionPath: Automated where the publication API supports scripted synthetic cycles; otherwise documented manual steps.

journeys.name: Transactional email/notification succeeds
journeys.expectedResult: A triggering action (e.g. synthetic join) results in the expected notification being queued/sent by the configured provider.
journeys.evidence: Provider-side send confirmation or queued-message log entry (no message content containing real PII).
journeys.privacyControl: Synthetic recipient address only (rehearsal-controlled inbox); no real member is notified.
journeys.defectRouting: Bounded remediation return per #2781 work unit 6.
journeys.executionPath: Automated: scripted trigger + provider API/log assertion.

journeys.name: Notification provider failure has a defined contingency
journeys.expectedResult: When the notification provider is unavailable, the triggering action still completes and a defined fallback/queue/retry path is recorded rather than a silent drop.
journeys.evidence: Captured behavior with the provider forced into a failure/mocked-unavailable state.
journeys.privacyControl: Synthetic recipient only.
journeys.cleanup: None required beyond standard synthetic-data cleanup.
journeys.defectRouting: Stop-and-escalate if failures are silently dropped with no recorded contingency.
journeys.executionPath: Automated: scripted trigger against a mocked/forced-failure provider endpoint.

journeys.name: Fundraiser enabled state behaves correctly
journeys.expectedResult: When the fundraiser flag is enabled, fundraiser surfaces render and hand off to the approved external provider boundary correctly.
journeys.evidence: Screenshot/response capture of fundraiser surface with the flag enabled in the rehearsal environment.
journeys.privacyControl: No real payment or donor data is entered; only the approved-provider boundary/handoff is verified, not a live transaction.
journeys.cleanup: None required (no real transaction is created).
journeys.defectRouting: Bounded remediation return per #2781 work unit 6.
journeys.executionPath: Automated: scripted GET of fundraiser surface with flag enabled; asserts expected external-provider link/boundary contract.

journeys.name: Fundraiser disabled state behaves correctly
journeys.expectedResult: When the fundraiser flag is disabled, fundraiser surfaces are hidden or show the approved disabled-state messaging; no broken/partial UI is shown.
journeys.evidence: Screenshot/response capture with the flag disabled.
journeys.privacyControl: No real payment or donor data involved.
journeys.defectRouting: Bounded remediation return per #2781 work unit 6.
journeys.executionPath: Automated: scripted GET of fundraiser surface with flag disabled; asserts expected disabled-state contract.

journeys.name: Deployment produces monitoring signal
journeys.expectedResult: A rehearsal deployment/update is observable in the monitoring surface (health collectors / dashboard) within the expected window.
journeys.evidence: Captured monitoring-surface state before/after the rehearsal deployment action.
journeys.privacyControl: No Production data involved; rehearsal environment only.
journeys.defectRouting: Bounded remediation return per #2781 work unit 6.
journeys.executionPath: Automated: reuse of the existing production-health-style collector pattern pointed at the rehearsal environment.

journeys.name: Incident intake routes correctly
journeys.expectedResult: A synthetic failure signal results in a routed, deduplicated Operations Issue (or equivalent rehearsal-scoped record), not a silent drop or duplicate spam.
journeys.evidence: Captured routing outcome (created/updated/held) for a synthetic failure signal.
journeys.privacyControl: No Production incident data used; synthetic signal only.
journeys.cleanup: Synthetic incident record closed/removed at rehearsal close.
journeys.defectRouting: Bounded remediation return per #2781 work unit 6.
journeys.executionPath: Automated: reuse of the existing ops-runtime-escalation dedup primitive against a rehearsal-scoped title/label.

journeys.name: Rollback and recovery restore a known-good state
journeys.expectedResult: Triggering the rehearsal rollback path restores the environment to its pre-change state with no residual synthetic taint.
journeys.evidence: Before/after state comparison (diff or checksum) of the rehearsal environment across the rollback cycle.
journeys.privacyControl: Rehearsal environment only; no Production rollback is exercised by this journey.
journeys.cleanup: Rollback itself is the cleanup step; confirm no orphaned synthetic state remains.
journeys.defectRouting: Stop-and-escalate if rollback does not fully restore state (unavailable-recovery-ownership protected stop).
journeys.executionPath: Automated where the rehearsal environment supports scripted rollback; otherwise documented manual runbook steps with recorded evidence.

journeys.name: Operator communication path fires on a rehearsal event
journeys.expectedResult: A defined rehearsal event (e.g. simulated failure) results in the expected operator-facing notification/comment, using only approved non-secret channels.
journeys.evidence: Captured notification/comment content (redacted of any secret) tied to the triggering event.
journeys.privacyControl: No credentials, tokens, or secret values are ever included in the communication payload.
journeys.cleanup: Rehearsal-scoped communication record removed/closed at rehearsal close where applicable.
journeys.defectRouting: Stop-and-escalate immediately if any secret/credential appears in a communication payload (protected stop).
journeys.executionPath: Automated: scripted trigger + assertion on the resulting communication payload's structure and absence of secret patterns.

journeys.name: Evidence closeout is complete and consistent
journeys.expectedResult: Every executed journey in a rehearsal run has a corresponding evidence record referencing the unchanged candidate identity, with no missing or orphaned entries.
journeys.evidence: Generated evidence-index cross-check (see `launch_rehearsal_harness.mjs --mode evidence-audit`).
journeys.privacyControl: Evidence records reference synthetic/rehearsal data only.
journeys.cleanup: None required (the evidence index itself is the retained artifact).
journeys.defectRouting: Stop-and-escalate if the evidence index is incomplete at rehearsal close — this blocks #2929's final disposition.
journeys.executionPath: Automated: `launch_rehearsal_harness.mjs --mode evidence-audit` cross-checks executed-journey evidence against the registry.
